reactions.generate_unavailable: Image CLI not available on this box
reactions.generate_note: Image generation needs an image CLI configured and a reachable image host.
reactions.generating: Generating on the image rig — this can take a minute…
reactions.safe_title: Visible to locked family devices, and firable from them.
reactions.test: Fire it now (no trace in the chat)
reactions.pool_note: One folder per mood; the bot pulls and spends an image from the folder each time it reacts (fired images move to spent/ and stay re-openable from their chat trace). Generated on the image rig to a per-mood target, topped up nightly; a mood below the low-water mark refills right away. Drop your own images into a mood folder — or make a new folder — and they are instantly in the rotation.
reactions.pool_enabled_hint: Off = only the named pack above is used.
reactions.pool_per_mood_hint: Unused images to keep on hand for each mood.
reactions.pool_min_hint: A mood under this refills right away; everything else waits for the nightly top-up.
reactions.pool_hour_hint: Local hour to top every mood back up to its target.
reactions.pool_safe_hint: Off = generated images stay behind the PIN.
reactions.pool_topup_title: Generate up to the per-mood targets
reactions.pool_replace_title: Discard every image on hand and regenerate the whole bank
reactions.pool_replace_confirm: Discard every image on hand and regenerate the whole bank?
reactions.pool_refilling: Generating on the image rig — the counts update as images land.
reactions.duration_hint: How long an overlay stays up before it self-dismisses.
reactions.cooldown_hint: Minimum gap between sends from the same sender.
reactions.queue_hint: Overlays held back during a burst; the oldest is dropped.
reactions.reseed_title: Re-render the built-in starter set. Your own uploads are untouched.
